item.title: Show HN: Embassia – LLM Search Console – Web crawlers talk to your site's agent
item.summary: You want to know what visitors are actually curious about. But there is no adequate tool for this. Not even the Google Search Console. Right now: -Crawlers use superficial queries. -They get data from your website. -You get zero deep intent. So we are building Embassia. -Integrate our agent on your website. -ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other crawlers talk directly to your site's agent. -They ask deep, specific questions. -Capture what your users are looking for, what they care about. -Shape your website and product based on real LLM and user intent. We believe the web shouldn't be a one-way street of passive scraping. By adding an interactive layer that turns static crawlers into active agents, You can now deeply understand your users at scale. Wanna get yours? Join the founders list on https://embassia.com/ I hope your week is going well so far.
